method: Reanalysis of every accepted sealed direct capture using the production demo_export.analyse. Width is measured SDK opening in metres; arm/width actions use the measured state at t+50 ms. Measured encoder targets do not encode finger holding force.

definitions.original_rgb: entire archived recording, includes pre-/post-task frames
definitions.grid_rows: 20Hz rows in task grid; invalid values retained in arrays, only valid chunk starts sampled
definitions.chunk_starts: length-10 label windows, including allowed repeat-last padding at episode end; overlap substantially
definitions.marker_coverage: number of full, valid unpadded chunks covering mark time t_start <= mark < t_start+0.5s; raw C/O clocked annotations can lag physical motion
definitions.motion_chunks: directional change of at least 1 mm over a full valid half-second window entirely before C or between C and O respectively
definitions.layout_independence: IDs, sessions and raw source paths verified; exact physical positional independence is not calibrated
definitions.exclusion: row reasons may overlap; width/joint raw violations counted only between task markers
definitions.rejected_attempts_scope: all *_teach dirs in three allocated sessions; observation, homing, commissioning and unrelated sessions outside denominator

start_poses.method: At the actual recorded task start, compute maximum absolute joint angle and pairwise L-infinity distance across the six joints of the blue/red starts for each declared layout. Minima before C come from actual received complete joint samples. The >30 deg then <10 deg counts below are descriptive, not collection cutoffs or calibrated Cartesian pose bounds.
